run_image_server: run the ImageServer to receive compressed color and depth images over TCP and republish as ROS topics
run_receive_png_script: run the receive_png script to start a local ROS node that displays incoming images at 15 Hz
create_image_server_with_display: create an ImageServer instance with show_images enabled to display color and depth frames in OpenCV windows
review_imagespin_loop: review the ImageServer spin method that receives WebP color and PNG depth images and publishes them as ROS Image messages
refactor_imageserver_ports: refactor the ImageServer to use configurable TCP ports instead of hardcoded 9990 for color and 9991 for depth
